CBSA.CICSBSA.ABNDFILE.recovery_why: etc/install/base/installjcl/BANK.csd: DEFINE FILE(ABNDFILE) ... RECOVERY(NONE) -- the abend log a backout must not undo

scenarios.name: three-accounts
scenarios.why: INQCUST finds customer 1 (sort code 987654): the cursor FETCHes its three accounts of the program's own sort code (not its 123456 one) into ACCOUNT-DETAILS 1-3 -- after the POINTER -- NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS 3, dates reformatted DDMMYYYY (2024-02-29 opened), 'Y'

scenarios.name: one-negative-loan
scenarios.why: one LOAN account: negative DECIMAL(12,2) balances into the signed S9(10)V99 fields after the POINTER; NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS 1

scenarios.name: customer-with-no-accounts
scenarios.why: INQCUST finds customer 3; the cursor's first FETCH is +100: NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS 0, 'Y'

scenarios.name: customer-not-on-file
scenarios.why: customer 5 has an account but no CUSTOMER record: INQCUST NOTFND, 'N'; CUSTOMER-FOUND 'N', COMM-FAIL-CODE '1', NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS 0, no SQL

scenarios.name: customer-zero
scenarios.why: CUSTOMER-NUMBER zero: not looked up (no LINK), CUSTOMER-FOUND 'N', COMM-FAIL-CODE '1', NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS 0

scenarios.name: customer-9999999999
scenarios.why: CUSTOMER-NUMBER 9999999999 (on the CUSTOMER file): not looked up either, 'N' / '1'

scenarios.name: null-statement-date
scenarios.why: customer 4's account has a NULL ACCOUNT_LAST_STATEMENT with no indicator: FETCH -305, CHECK-FOR-STORM-DRAIN-DB2, then the program's failure path

scenarios.name: caller-leaves-data
scenarios.why: the caller's COMMAREA arrives with account 1's fields already holding text (as BNK1CCA's working storage might): every field after the POINTER is overwritten

notes: CBSA's inquire-accounts-for-customer service (INQACCCU, LINKed with the INQACCCU copybook's COMMAREA by BNK1CCA, CREACC and DELCUS). Its COMMAREA carries data after a POINTER (COMM-PCB-POINTER, then ACCOUNT-DETAILS OCCURS 1 TO 20 DEPENDING ON NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS): a POINTER is 4 bytes on z/OS and 8 under the oracle (oracle_assumptions.md C9), so each side's COMMAREA is read by its own layout and compared by name, the POINTER only as NULL. CUSTOMER-NUMBER zero or 9999999999 is not looked up; otherwise INQCUST is LINKed (run in the same task: READ FILE('CUSTOMER') by the program's own sort code, 987654) and, when it finds the customer, ACC-CURSOR is OPENed on the customer number and the program's own sort code (no ORDER BY: the order is Db2's, the same Db2 on both sides) and FETCHed into ACCOUNT-DETAILS until +100 or 20 accounts. A FETCH error (-305: a NULL date with no indicator) takes the program's failure path. The COMMAREA's OCCURS fields are compared at the first occurrence and NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS (the harness's layout lists an OCCURS group's fields once); ACCOUNT, CUSTOMER and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. Data: seed.sql and customer.txt are SYNTHETIC (customer.txt is cbsa-updcust's).
